name: mpmb-copilot
description: Tooling and quality gates for the MPMB-Copilot monorepo

scripts.dev: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check backend/app tests scripts
scripts.lint:py:fix: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check backend/app tests scripts --fix
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:py
scripts.format:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format backend/app tests scripts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:py
scripts.format:check:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format backend/app tests scripts --check
scripts.typecheck: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev mypy backend/app
scripts.test: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev pytest tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run typecheck

*.py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check --fix
uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format
